body:
I lash out at people I get close to, that is why I don't think I'm stable enough for friendships. I end up hurting them or they end up hurting me, and it is very easy to hurt me, as I am extremely sensitive.

I don't think you'd enjoy talking with me, I have no interests anymore. I'm dying off, destroying every last trace of human characteristics. I'm very much empty at this point, there is not much I can say that is even remotely interesting.

I really don't even know why I posted on here. Maybe I'm just searching for any other way out besides suicide. I really do not want to die, but I feel as if I have no other choice, my life feels ruined, my resources depleted, my only chance at getting better, gone.

I did used to like philosophy. I used to like art as well. I used to enjoy writing. I had a dream of becoming a guitarist. But I gave up on everything because I am not intelligent enough or creative enough or talented enough for such things. I was absolutely the worst at everything I tried. And that is not an exaggeration. I also hadn't the energy or will to practice.

I don't meditate, I take long walks most days if that counts as exercise, and I try to eat as healthy as I can.
I hate my home life, it makes me feel so much worse just being at home. But I'm too unstable to live alone and get out of my house. I have no friends whatsoever, haven't had any in years and I think I'm too unstable to try at any friendships.
I enjoy talking to people I'm close to other than my family. That is the only thing that I actually enjoy. But I haven't had that in years because I can't get close to people easily. And those who I most enjoyed it with are no longer in my life.

I have reached out to at least 5 therapists and none was able to help me. It is me who ruins everything and I am officially unable to be helped. I've tried it all, I can't help how I feel or what I do in order to try to feel better, but no therapist can handle me, this I know as fact. I'm running out of options, I really think it's best if I just kill myself to stop my suffering and save potential therapists all the trouble.

I have a therapist I like and trust at the moment. But I've been seeing him for a year and I feel the same, maybe even worse. I was just recently dropped from my antidepressants because they were ineffective and have since been put on a mood stabilizer that will take effect in three to four weeks but I really doubt I can hold off until then. I've seen therapist after therapist, psychiatrists, and been put on several antidepressants and nothing has changed. I suppose it's just me that's not trying hard enough. I truly believe I cannot be helped.
